introduction.text: ColorOS 16 explores a more personal, comfortable mobile experience through natural visual cues, immersive lock screens, expressive themes, and everyday system apps. This project connects UX strategy with a coherent visual language, using light, color, and motion to make daily interactions clear and expressive.

localArtwork.observed: Cover says OS 16 UX STRATEGY and Dragonlee Design.
Audience and emotional insight summary addresses inner confidence, interests, and self-expression.
Design direction moves through natural perception, self-reflection, and free expression.
Overview shows expressive lock screens, weather, system apps, and AI service cards.
